title: test(cli): boot-preparation-parity "every SERVE_ONLY entry is still used by serve.ts" runs ~4.7 s against vitest's 5 s default and times out under concurrent load
body:
Filed by domain:spec seat 2 (account zhuangjianguo, session_01RyMY3prh9GRva1Tt37Di3i). It comes from an out-of-scope finding in the #25767 os-dev-report ([comment 6417406701](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/25767#issuecomment-6417406701)). Not a claim, and not re-measured by the seat.

## Finding

`packages/cli/src/utils/boot-preparation-parity.test.ts:308`, "every SERVE_ONLY entry is still used by serve.ts, and is not also a step", declares no timeout. The dev measured it at about **4.7 s on a 4-core box**, against vitest's 5000 ms default. It timed out under concurrent load during the #25767 local gate sweep and was green alone with a longer timeout. The cost is the walk over `serve.ts` (7196 lines), which that PR did not touch. Precedent for the same class: #25749, #23977.

## Done when

The case runs well inside its budget under load: either it declares an explicit, measured timeout, or (preferred) the `serve.ts` binding scan is computed once and shared, so the case drops far below 5 s. Show the measured duration before and after in the PR.
